title: Nevers to Revol, Aug-Oct 1593, BnF fr. 3985 and fr. 3986, in the Court symbol cipher no. 60 (catalogue item 21, part)

steps.what: Gallica full-resolution canvases of fr. 3985, 3986, 3995 fetched; items mapped to folios.
Revol letters found to be in the Court key no. 60, not no. 46; the 27 Aug copy is in clear.
Key no. 60 transcribed in full from fr. 3995 ff. 109-111 and checked on the interlined King's letter of 7 Oct.
f. 146v and f. 157v transcribed and decoded; anchors only, copyist's cursive forms block the rest.
Instruction of 31 Aug found in print (Memoires de Nevers ii) and interlined in fr. 3985; glyph atlas begun.
Outside input, issue #32 (tunarob): 14 proposed key no. 60 corrections, a 4/2+ tag split, transcription of fr. 3985 f. 88r-v and a manual partial reading of f. 88r (LLM-assisted).

Each key correction checked on full-resolution fr. 3995 f. 109 and f. 111: 10 confirmed and adopted (b = o-, c flag, i hook+, o \\, m ɱ, u 2+, ‡/‡-loop, ♀ = u, ∩+ = g, o-o = c, o+o = y), 2 rejected (be, # in compounds); tags ſ+/4+/4+b/4/2+/n+ split.
f. 146v and f. 157v re-tagged and re-decoded with the corrected key; unresolved 29/204 and 68/226 tokens, no new reading.
f. 88r R5 'de absolution' (needs the corrected b), R6 oo+ le Roy and f++ qu'il, checked on the image; Tomokiyo's 'conversion' rejected (needs q = c).
f88/shuffle_control.py: longest lexicon word over 86 R3-R6 tokens = 10 letters (absolution); 0/5000 token permutations reach it, P = 0.0002.

Split from nevers1593 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): key no. 60 and the Revol letters are their own entry; fr. 3986 no. 68 (7 Oct), listed as not located in the first session, identified as f. 146v from Tomokiyo's list.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): f. 88 (issue #32 transcription), f. 146v and f. 157v transcriptions with decode60.py output saved to texts/ (decoder output, not readings); ff. 115, 176, 198 were never transcribed

Reading audit (George Lasry's test: can a reader build coherent sentences and translate them?). texts/f88_decode60.txt, f146v_decode60.txt and f157v_decode60.txt read: token-by-token decoder output, headed 'NOT a reading', with a few anchors and nothing between them that reads. All three entries relabelled decoded, not read; class read in part -> not read, method read with known key -> not solved (key kept as a part); fraction_read unknown -> 0 (estimated).

outcome.method_basis: Key no. 60, the Court cipher given to Nevers (BnF fr. 3995 ff. 108-111), identified by Tomokiyo and applied (read with known key, recorded under parts), gives three words on f. 88r and anchors on f. 146v; no passage reads as text.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: no passage builds sentences, so nothing counts as read (0; estimated because three of six passages are untranscribed). Earlier figure was 'unknown'; no reading figure is withdrawn.
outcome.notes: Read in part only on f. 88r; the blocker so far is palaeographic (the copyist's cursive forms), and three passages are still to transcribe (Status: in progress).

gaps.detail: bitonal microfilm copy in the copyist's cursive, the contributor's transcription has variant readings at about one sign in six and no colour scan exists
transcribed by the contributor (116 units, issue #32), no reading under key no. 60; not re-transcribed here
located and cut but never transcribed; key no. 60 is fully in hand

texts.label: BnF fr. 3985 f. 88r-v, 21 Aug 1593
texts.summary: Nevers to Louis de Revol, secretary of state, on the papal absolution of Henri IV; the transcription is Robert Węglarek's (tunarob, issue #32). Only 'de absolution' (shuffle-controlled), 'le Roy' and 'qu'il' read; the decoder output with key no. 60 is given as it stands, not as a reading.
texts.note: Token-by-token decoder output with key no. 60, headed 'NOT a reading': three words (de absolution, le Roy, qu'il) among unresolved tokens; no sentence (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

texts.label: BnF fr. 3986 f. 146v, 7 Oct 1593
texts.summary: Nevers to Revol, 7 Oct 1593. Tomokiyo's anchors (l'absolution, à la vérité, intérêt) come out of key no. 60, but the text between them does not yet read; decoder output only.
texts.note: Decoder output: Tomokiyo's anchors (l'absolution, à la vérité, intérêt) come out of the table, the text between them does not read (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

texts.label: BnF fr. 3986 f. 157v, Coire, 9 Oct 1593
texts.summary: Nevers to Revol from Coire, 9 Oct 1593: about 90 symbols in the first lines of f. 157v; no anchor secured, and the transcription over-reads faded clear cursive as cipher (NOTES). Decoder output only.
texts.note: Decoder output on a faded passage where clear cursive and cipher run together; nothing reads (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

parts.label: ff. 88r, 146v, 157v (key no. 60 applied; decoded, not read)
parts.basis: key no. 60 transcribed and corrected from issue #32; three words on f. 88r (shuffle-controlled), anchors on f. 146v. Decoded, not read (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

prior.where: Tomokiyo (cryptiana henryiv2.htm) decoded three words of f. 146v (l'absolution, a la verite, interest) and guessed 'conversion' on f. 88r
